covers: raylib's core_vr_simulator: LoadVrStereoConfig for the Oculus Rift CV1, BeginVrStereoMode and EndVrStereoMode around BeginMode3D drawing a cube, its wires, a grid (the batch, drawn once for each eye in its half of a 2160 x 1200 render texture through the eye's view offset and projection) and a sphere model (a mesh, its mvp alone moved to each eye), the render texture drawn onto an 800 x 450 screen through raylib's distortion330.fs, its uniforms' initializers in the GLSL and SetShaderValue's values
notes: The example's camera input, cursor and DrawFPS are left out, so every frame is the same. GL: 65 pixels differ, each in one channel at the cube's and the wires' edges, which the distortion's chromatic aberration reads apart (red, green and blue each sampled at a place of its own), so an edge rasterized a texel apart in the 2160 x 1200 texture shows in one channel. SDL_GPU (Vulkan on lavapipe): about 950 such, its lines and edges rasterized apart from llvmpipe's.
